scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @localspace/server" "npm run dev -w @localspace/web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @localspace/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @localspace/server && npm run typecheck -w @localspace/web
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run test:e2e
